name: Kujou Yukito
source:
Yukito is a junior, and a trouble-maker who always gets into fights. He is the captain of the boxing club, and has amazing athletic ability. But he isn't the brightest person, and his one-track mind leads to violence, which leads to trouble. His weak point is artifice and his special ability is quarreling.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/empusa/empusa.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
